about: Ask Timmy's test set (vault/reference/ask-timmy.md). tools/timmy/eval.mjs sends each case through the function's own code (core.js) to the real API and grades the answer. Every case also gets the checks every answer must pass: no error, every quote checks out, plain text, nothing from his rules or the About page's spoilers. 'paste' builds a practice question from the hub's own questions.json (choices shuffled, the key never named), so its key is checked too. 'ask' is Ask Timmy on a question card, which the eval records as answered first. 'then' continues the same chat. Lecture refs are the corpus's: L<n> in core.json order ('<hub>:L<n>' on the dashboard). The graded quiz questions here are made up for the test: never a real quiz, take-home or exam question (vault/rules/graded-coursework.md). Check the test set itself with: node tools/timmy/eval.mjs --dry The rs- cases are Review of Systems, a hub of courses: each reads one course's part first (core.js COURSE_NOTE), rs-03 asks about another course and so reads the whole content too, rs-07 is not covered anywhere.
